$comment: Release-wide policy the pipeline stamps into the manifest. Committed so a release's criticality is a
reviewed change, not an ad-hoc button. 'critical' can also be overridden per run via a workflow_dispatch
input; a plain tag push uses the value here.
minSupportedVersion: any install below this floor is treated as critical even when 'critical' is false
(a security floor without flagging every release). Empty = no floor.
